title: My smart doorbell keeps recording someone knocking at 3 AM. The footage shows an empty porch.
transcript:
My smart doorbell keeps recording someone knocking at 3 AM. The footage shows an empty porch. The first alert came Tuesday at 3:02 AM. Motion detected, front door.

I watched the clip in bed. Three slow knocks. The porch was empty. The light was on, the street was dead quiet, and nothing was there.

Wednesday it happened again. Same minute. The knocks were faster this time, and the picture shook, like the door was being hit by something heavy.

Thursday I stayed up with the lights off. At 3:02 my phone buzzed. Motion detected, front door. I opened the live view. Empty porch. Then I heard it, three slow knocks, but not from my phone.

From inside the house.

I opened Tuesday's clip again and zoomed in. Past the empty porch, reflected in the glass of the door, was my own staircase behind the camera. Something was sitting on the third step with its hands folded, perfectly still, facing the wall.

On Wednesday's clip it was on the second step. On Thursday's it was on the first.

I looked up from my phone. The hallway light was off. I could hear it breathing near the bottom of the stairs, waiting for the knock to be answered.

It isn't knocking to get in.

It's knocking for me.
